title: sail-pins-its-refusals
intention: SAIL'S REFUSAL CONTRACT GETS TEETH — the skill's edge (b) proof lands. skills/sail/proofs/ pins what the prose promises: the no-berths / no-ticket refusal contract of step 0, the step ORDER the physics demands (answer-the-chart strictly before the PROVED crossing; BUILDME journal before build; seal after PROVEME), and the named-gate references (ExitGateRed, BuildGateRed, the entry gate) — so a future edit of SKILL.md that drops a step, reorders the liturgy, or orphans a gate name goes red instead of silently teaching the wrong liturgy. The charter said this proof waits 'until the skill has enough crossings to know its real failure modes'; five full crossings later (decompose voyage, triage/hypothesize/validate stones, both gate stones), the failure modes are dated and known.
why: sail charter filed edge (b) verbatim: 'a /sail proof (skills/sail/proofs/) pinning the refusal contract — no berths / no ticket — once the skill has enough crossings to know its real failure modes.' The skill is prose-as-implementation; its underlying physics is proven elsewhere (chokepoint, doors, tester), but the PROSE is what every delegated builder reads first — and the budget plan makes cheaper-model builders read it with minimal context. A liturgy document that can drift silently is exactly what a low-context builder cannot catch; the proof is the tripwire.
traces_to: Law 8 — a hollow SKILL.md (steps dropped or reordered) could today pass every gate because no proof reads the prose; this closes that

Law 4 — the wrong-shape signal in sail's own falsifier ('if /sail crossings routinely skip steps... the discipline needs to move down the ladder') needs an instrument at the prose layer to fire at all
Law 5 — the skill's proofs berth beside the skill (skills/sail/proofs/), the standing co-location rule
Law 3 — 'the skill teaches the right order' becomes a measured claim (the exit stone's verdict already measured it once, by grep — this makes that instrument standing)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth beside the skill — the refusal contract present and imperative (no berths → /chart first; un-cast → /sorted first); step order asserted structurally (answer-the-chart < PROVED crossing; BUILDME < build; seal follows PROVEME); every named gate class resolves against the real code (an ExitGateRed mention that no longer imports is a red); teeth green twice, sealed under netns. Live gate: the proof runs against the real SKILL.md, not a fixture copy.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the proof passing a SKILL.md with the answer-the-chart act after the PROVED crossing; a named gate class the code no longer defines passing unnoticed; the proof reading a fixture instead of the real skill file; the proof pinning prose wording so tightly that an honest rewording reds (the pinned-cursor defect transposed to prose — pin structure and names, not phrasing).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when skill@v1 registration lands (skills-ride-the-chokepoint) — a journaled skill voyage may carry some of this contract as crossing physics; when /chart's skill wants the same tripwire (second instance earns the shared shape); when SKILL.md is next restructured.

how: Build /sail proof at skills/sail/proofs/ that pins the refusal contract: no-berths / no-ticket refusal conditions fire and are recorded.

chart_notes.constrain: what the proof may pin (structure, order, resolving names) vs may not (phrasing) — the pinned-cursor lesson applied to prose; and whether the proof berths under skills/sail/proofs/ get sealed by the tester like code proofs (the skill is class-space code enough)
chart_notes.survey: what the exit stone's verdict already measured by grep (the standing instrument to compose); what test patterns exist for prose-reading proofs, if any
